newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek 97 draft budget to be finalised early November.
newsitem.headline: Greek 97 draft budget to be finalised early November.

text.p: Greek Deputy Finance Minister Nikos Christodoulakis said on Friday the basic figures of the 1997 draft budget would be finalised in early November.
Last night newly-elected socialist Prime Minister Costas Simitis said he wanted to cut spending, make the wealthy pay their fair share and intensify the fight against tax evasion.

Christodoulakis was speaking to reporters after meeting National Economy and Finance Minister Yannos Papandoniou to discuss a draft bill about limiting public sector spending. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
